meta_description:
224K likes, 1,107 comments - nasa on October 14, 2026: "As we watch stars shine in the night sky, we shine right back at them. 🌟

This photo of Egypt’s Nile River was taken aboard the @ISS as it soared above Earth. The river sparkles with city lights, highlighting where people live along the waterways.

#Astrophotography #Earth #Egypt".
